description: Uncertain entries of the world model: `entry` names the fact left open ({of, attr, time}; `of` "?" when the question is who). `raised`: the paragraph (and quote) where the story opens it; null while the story never doubts it (`latent`). `possibilities`: every answer the story makes available, each `{value, how?, available, via, from?, quote?, out?, by?}`. `available` is the paragraph from which the answer may be listed; `via` is `direct` (the story names it as a possibility), `indirect` (it follows from what has been told, or a careful reader's thought: `from` a fact or "thought t<id>") or `always` ("something else", on every question from the paragraph it is raised). `quote` is the words that make it available, found in that paragraph (for answers that become available after the facts so far run out). `out`/`by`: the paragraph and fact that rule it out. `answer` is always one of the possibilities, or null where the story never settles it. `old`: the old game's question or slot.

He took a piece of white paper folded up out of his waistcoat pocket
